BiblicalUsage: Mezahab is named twice, as the father of Matred and grandfather of Mehetabel, the wife of Hadar king of Edom. He is an Edomite remembered only through his daughter and granddaughter, in the genealogy of Edom's kings.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name kept only in a genealogy still testifies: Mezahab's line reached the throne of Edom, and Scripture keeps the record even when the man himself is silent.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
